name: mosa-safari-admin-cloudflare
author: Mohamed Salem
description: Isolated hardened Cloudflare Workers control plane for Mosa Safari Admin Dashboard

scripts.sync: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public/assets/css public/assets/js/data public/assets/images && cp ../admin.html public/index.html && printf 'User-agent: *\nDisallow: /\n' > public/robots.txt && cp ../assets/css/tailwind.css ../assets/css/admin.css public/assets/css/ && cp ../assets/js/admin.js public/assets/js/ && cp ../assets/js/data/trips.js public/assets/js/data/ && cp -r ../assets/images/* public/assets/images/
